Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Our Product Marketing team’s mission is to generate customer insights that inform Stripe’s product strategy, and lead go-to-market for our suite of products. Product Marketing is a highly cross-functional role at Stripe, partnering closely with Product and Engineering, Sales, Partnerships, Demand Generation and Campaigns to name a few. Different from many other Product Marketing teams, our team works across the entire product lifecycle, from helping shape the product, to driving launch and commercialization, to growing product adoption post-launch.

jobs.description_text:
Xantium Group is looking for a Recruiter to join at a pivotal point in the Firm’s growth, with the opportunity to shape the talent coming in and the processes behind how we recruit. You'll lead searches across quantitative research, trading, and analysis, bringing the market knowledge and judgment to identify and attract exceptional candidates. 

Beyond delivering on immediate priorities, you'll help build the capabilities we need as we scale. Working closely with hiring managers, you'll develop targeted talent strategies, cultivate relationships, and strengthen our systems and interview practices. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys a fast pace and takes equal ownership of filling roles and advancing longer-term projects. 

 Key Responsibilities 

  • -Own end-to-end recruitment for front-office positions, from role scoping through assessment, offer negotiation, and closing. 
  • -Partner with hiring managers and business leaders to understand investment strategies, hiring priorities, and the commercial impact of each hire.

jobs.description_text:
The Firm

XTX Markets is a leading algorithmic trading firm which uses state-of-the-art machine learning technology to produce price forecasts for 53,000 financial instruments across equities, fixed income, currencies, commodities and crypto. It uses those forecasts to trade on exchanges and alternative trading venues, and to offer differentiated liquidity directly to clients worldwide. The firm trades over $250bn a day across 35 countries and has over 300 employees based in London, Singapore, New York, Paris, Bristol, Mumbai, Yerevan and Kajaani.

 

We leverage the talent of the people who work here, modern computational techniques and state-of-the-art research infrastructure to analyse large data sets across markets quickly and efficiently, to maximize the effectiveness of our proprietary trading algorithms. We are actively seeking new methods and ideas. The models that drive our trading strategies have evolved considerably over the last 10 years, from econometric methods that gave our company its name, to trees, to neural networks, to modern deep learning architectures.

 

XTX Markets has an unrivalled level of computational resources in the trading industry, with a growing research cluster currently containing over 25,000 GPUs with 1 exabyte of usable storage. Teams across the firm include world-class researchers, developers and technologists with backgrounds in pure math, programming, physics, computer science

jobs.title: Forecasting Analyst I
jobs.description_text:
Join the Market Leader in Electric Power Data and Analytics Solutions

The electrical grid is the largest and most complicated machine ever built. Yes Energy’s industry-leading electric power trading analytics software provides real-time visibility into the massive amount of data generated by the North American electrical grid daily. Our unique and innovative view of the data informs real-time trading decisions and mid-to-long-term investment decisions that keep utility prices low, support the energy transition, and keep the grid running. It’s both challenging work and work with a purpose.

Be a part of our successful, growing business during international transformation.

Position Summary

As a Forecasting Analyst I, you will be responsible for the delivery and accuracy of forecasts supporting a portfolio of clients. You will participate in various activities, including processing and managing data, building new and maintaining existing models, becoming a subject matter expert on relevant aspects of the energy industry, and developing strong working relationships with clients inside that portfolio.

jobs.title: Customer  Success  Associate
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Customer Success Associate to join our team in Toronto! As a Customer Success Associate you will be responsible for driving strategy for the Achievers recognition and engagement platform while continuously driving value for our customers. You will play a key role with our customers by promoting product adoption and expansion, highlighting best practices and implementing recognition strategies. If you are passionate about customer success, have a knack for sales and a flare for technology you’ll fit right in!

jobs.title: Customer Support Advisor
jobs.description_text: A Customer Support Advisor is a highly skilled, customer-focused professional responsible for delivering exceptional support to both program administrators (clients) and members. This role primarily supports program administrators (CSS function) while also contributing to Member Support to ensure seamless end-to-end service. In this role, you will own a diverse portfolio of support cases, including complex and escalated issues. You bring a strong understanding of the platform, apply advanced problem-solving skills, and collaborate cross-functionally to drive timely and effective resolutions. You are viewed as a trusted resource within the team and contribute to elevating overall support quality.

jobs.title: Customer Value & Growth Program Manager
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Customer Value & Growth Program Manager to own and drive the company-wide program that ensures our customers realize the value of their investment with Achievers and incrementally grow their spend with us as a result. Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Marketplace, Enablement, Revenue Operations and Finance each own a piece of this today. You will sit at the centre, pulling those pieces into one integrated strategy, guiding and collaborating with each team as they build their part, and making sure everything we do aligns to a consistent vision. You are accountable for making sure the right plans exist, that they connect, and that the functions who deliver them are set up to execute. Your impact comes from how well you align, equip and drive the people closest to our customers. The role goes beyond program management. We are looking for someone who brings a commercial point of view, challenges the plans on the table, contributes to the thinking, and acts as a genuine partner to every function involved.

jobs.title: Finance Manager, Marketplace ⭐
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a highly motivated and analytical SFA/Manager to take full ownership of our global e-commerce Marketplace P&L, one of Achievers' most important revenue streams. This role sits at the intersection of Finance, Business Intelligence, Customer Success, Merchandising, and Product, translating Marketplace activity into financial insight, strategic forecasting, and operational action. You won't just report the numbers - you'll explain what happened, forecast what comes next, and actively shape the strategy and direction to help support growth. From building predictive models and share-of-wallet analyses to partnering with Customer Success on NRR strategy and existing customer ARR forecasting, this is a role for someone who wants to make a measurable impact across the business. If you bring experience from e-commerce, retail, or a rewards/marketplace environment, that's a significant advantage, you'll hit the ground running with an intuitive understanding of redemption and e-commerce dynamics, catalogue economics, and customer purchasing behavior that are central to this role.

jobs.title: Global Payroll and Benefits Administrator
jobs.description_text: Achievers is hiring a Global Payroll and Benefits Administrator on an 18-month contract to provide maternity leave coverage to run Canadian and US payroll and own benefits administration for both countries. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Global Payroll & Benefits, you will process bi-weekly payrolls in Workday (Canada) and ADP Workforce Now (US), manage remittances, year-end, payroll/benefits journal entries and back up global payroll delivery through Remote.

jobs.title: Mid-Market Account Executive
jobs.description_text: About Achievers Achievers offers more than just a thank you program. Our employee recognition and rewards software inspires employees to recognize everyone, every day, everywhere. With 4.3 million global users, we empower employees across 190 countries. Visit us at achievers.com to learn more and check out our platform in action. Join our team of A-players who bring passion to our purpose and believe that meaningful change creates extraordinary outcomes — together, we’ll inspire recognition everywhere and achieve results that matter. Our commitment to you: At Achievers, we hire you for you because we value the unique perspective and individuality that each person brings to our team. We are committed to creating an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace where you belong, and your contributions are celebrated. Together, we achieve more by combining our unique strengths, fostering collaboration, and inspiring each other to reach new heights. The Opportunity: We’re looking for a Mid-Market Account Executive to join our growing sales team in Sydney! In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to drive meaningful impact by helping mid-sized businesses achieve their goals through our solutions. You’ll take ownership of identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and driving revenue growth within the mid-market segment.

jobs.description_text: As a Senior HR Business Partner, you will serve as a strategic advisor to leaders, helping them build high-performing teams, make informed workforce decisions, and drive organizational effectiveness. You will leverage business insight, workforce data, and talent expertise to influence decisions, strengthen leadership capability, and improve business outcomes. This role operates with significant autonomy and partners with leaders across North America, EMEA, and APAC.

We're experiencing exponential growth and expanding our go-to-market engine through strategic partnerships. Own the end-to-end partner lifecycle: selection, onboarding, GTM strategy, enablement, and revenue delivery. You'll be measured on partner-sourced customer opportunities and deal closure. Reports to: Global Head of Partnerships | Works with: NA Sales Leader and regional reps across all NA sales regions Compensation & Accountability 70% of annual quota is based on partner-sourced opportunities delivered to Actian sales. This is a revenue-accountable role where success is measured by the volume, quality, and closing rate of customer opportunities your partner relationships generate for the field sales team. The remaining 30% focuses on partner enablement, solution co-creation, GTM strategy, and ecosystem management.

jobs.title: Manager, Global Practice and Delivery (Solutions & Services)
jobs.description_text: We're looking for a Manager, Global Practice and Delivery to build, lead, and scale a global team of Solutions Consultants and Forward-Deployed Engineers responsible for enterprise implementations, technical consulting, SaaS deployments, and platform migrations. You'll lead our North American services organization while helping shape global delivery practices that enable customers to successfully deploy, adopt, and realize measurable value from Acceldata's data management and observability solutions. You'll build a scalable services delivery engine, ensuring customer engagements are delivered on time, within budget, to high-quality standards, and consistently across multiple customers. You should be equally comfortable discussing data architecture trade-offs with a customer's technical team and coaching Solutions Consultant Or/And , Forward-Deployed Engineers on delivering complex on-premises and SaaS solutions. Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.  

We’re here to give power to the patient. 

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

jobs.description_text: Company Description Anomali, headquartered in Silicon Valley, delivers the first Intelligence-Native Agentic SOC Platform — unifying a security data lake, the world's largest IOC repository, threat intelligence, and agentic AI into a single modern experience. The platform accelerates detection, investigation, and response, delivering earlier insights, faster action, and scalable modernization across any environment. Whether augmenting existing tools or delivering complete SOC capabilities end-to-end, Anomali empowers security teams to operate faster, smarter, and with confidence. Beyond Detecting. Start Deciding. Start Acting. Learn more at www.anomali.com Job DescriptionAnomali sells a security platform into enterprise buying committees across Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Asia Pacific. The international business is where most of our revenue is earned, and it runs on quotes, order packages, contract paperwork and clean pipeline data. Today that support runs on US Pacific hours. Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

jobs.title: Credit & Collection Specialist, EMEA
jobs.description_text: Who We Are: At Brooks, we believe movement is the key to feeling more alive. That’s why we’re driven to create gear and experiences that take people to the place that makes them feel more alive — whether it’s a headspace, a feeling or a finish line. Everyone who works at Brooks is propelled by a company culture that sparks excitement, fuels collaboration, inspires creativity, and ignites innovation. Our brand values help bond us together and drive our success: • Runner First - We act in the best interest of the runner • Word is Bond - We do what we say we’ll do • Champion Heart - We give our all in everything we do • There is no “I” in Run - We stay generous with our humanity • Keep Moving - We find ways to move every day, because joy is kinetic! We welcome everyone from every walk of life looking to inspire others through the power of movement — because we’re all moving towards something. Let’s run there. jobs.description_text: 클로버추얼패션 (CLO Virtual Fashion)은 3D 의상 시뮬레이션 알고리즘을 기반으로, 컨셉부터 디자인, 제조, 마케팅, 피팅, 스타일링까지 의상과 관련된 모든 서비스를 제공합니다. 2009년 설립된 클로버추얼패션은 3D 의상 시뮬레이션 알고리즘에 대한 독보적인 기술력을 바탕으로, 디지털 패션의 새로운 생태계를 만들어 가고 있습니다. 의상 디자인 소프트웨어 CLO, Marvelous Designer, Jinny와 함께, CLO-SET, CONNECT와 같은 의상 콘텐츠에 특화된 플랫폼으로 의상의 모든 여정에 관여하여 효율적이고 지속가능한 워크플로우를 구축하고 있습니다. 뿐만 아니라, 당사 솔루션을 통해 실제 의상과 디지털 의상이 서로 태그되어 CLO 시스템 내에서 기능할 수 있게끔 합니다. 글로벌 디지털 패션 시장을 주도하고 있는 클로버추얼패션은 현재 아시아, 북미, 유럽, 남미 등 전 세계 12개국에 총 16개의 오피스를 두고 있으며, 세계 각국의 수많은 고객사를 바탕으로 점점 확장해나가고 있습니다. [CLO의 소프트웨어] CLO:https://www.clo3d.com Marvelous Designer:https://www.marvelousdesigner.com Jinny:https://connect.clo-set.com/jinny [CLO의 플랫폼] CLO-SET:https://style.clo-set.com/aboutus CONNECT:https://connect.clo-set.com/ [전세계 디자이너의 일하는 방식을 바꿔놓은 회사 - EO] https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RG8LFEKg1D8 [클로버추얼패션 채용 홈페이지] https://www.clovirtualfashion-careers.com/ Position Overview 클로버추얼패션의 Finance & Accounting Chapter는 회사의 숫자가 정확하고 투명하게 기록되도록 하고, 이를 바탕으로 회사가 올바른 의사결정을 내리고 지속적으로 성장할 수 있도록 돕습니다. 회사의 다음 성장 단계를 준비하는 여러 프로젝트를 진행함에 있어, 실무의 멤버로 참여하며 재무 전반의 경험을 함께하실 Accounting Associate를 선발합니다. 금번 포지션은 법인카드 및 일반비용 관리, 국내 매출 대사, 자금 반제 처리 등의 실무를 주도하며 데이터의 정합성을 높입니다. 특히, AI 네이티브 환경에 맞추어 단순 반복 업무와 서류 작업을 자동화하고 재무 워크플로우의 생산성을 극대화하는 과정을 함께할 분을 찾습니다. Position Overview CLO Virtual Fashion의 글로벌 웹 기반 플랫폼과 서비스의 백엔드 개발에 참여할 동료를 모집합니다. 본 포지션은 CLO-SET, CONNECT와 같은 의상 콘텐츠 관리 및 협업 플랫폼에 직접 참여하여, 고도화된 백엔드 서비스를 설계하고 구현하는 중요한 역할을 수행합니다. 플랫폼 서비스의 안정성과 확장성을 책임지는 백엔드 API 서버와 각종 Worker 서비스의 개발 및 구현을 담당하게 됩니다. 나아가 서비스 운영에 필수적인 검색 데이터 연동, 그리고 대용량 데이터 처리를 위한 다양한 백엔드 기술 통합을 경험하고 주도합니다. 최종적으로는 프론트엔드를 포함한 다양한 유관 부서와의 긴밀한 협업을 통해, 의상 콘텐츠에 특화된 글로벌 플랫폼 서비스의 전반적인 기능을 설계하고 완성도 높은 제품을 만들어나갈 기회가 주어집니다. 기술 스택 (Tech Stack) Core: Kotlin/JAVA, Spring WebFlux/WebMVC, Coroutines Infra: Azure, AWS, K8s(optional), Docker AI Tools: Claude, Gemini Data: MS-SQL, Redis Monitoring: Datadog Hiring Process [서류 검토] → [과제 전형] → [1차 인터뷰] → [2차 인터뷰(+Reference Check)] → [처우 협의] → [최종 합격] *이력서를 제출하실 때 본인의 업무 이력과 역할, 그리고 그 과정에서 어떠한 부분을 느끼고 성장했는지 적어 주시면 좋습니다. *2차 인터뷰 조율 과정에서 레퍼런스 체크 요청을 드리고 있습니다. *각 전형에 대한 상세 안내는 메일을 통해 안내해 드리고 있습니다.

Since 2009, CLO has been building a dynamic digital fashion ecosystem, driven by its industry-leading simulation algorithms that blend the physical and virtual worlds of clothing. Our suite of tools—including CLO, Marvelous Designer, and Jinny—streamlines every stage of the garment creation process, while platforms like CLO-SET and CONNECT enable seamless collaboration, content management, and digital asset workflows. Through smart tagging technology, CLO also links physical and digital garments, creating an integrated and intelligent fashion infrastructure built for the future of design and sustainability. CLO Virtual Fashion, a global leader in digital fashion innovation, operates across 16 offices in 13 countries—including key hubs in Asia, North America, Europe, and South America. As the demand for immersive, tech-driven fashion solutions grows, CLO continues to expand its global footprint, powered by a rapidly growing international user base and a future-focused vision. jobs.title: DIS-TRAN Packaged Substations Transfer Portal - Assembly Supervisor
jobs.description_text: Come join our collaborative and innovative team at DIS-TRAN Packaged Substations! DIS-TRAN Packaged Substations has been an industry leader in the design and supply of high-voltage, open-air substations, and switchyards since 1965. Over a half-century of building meaningful relationships with our customers and vendors boils down to one thing: people. We take pride in our collaborative approach where everything we do is designed to deliver the project the right way, your way. Though we have grown over the years, and now offer new innovations like our Factory-Built Substations, our age-old commitment will never change: to take care of you like family. The Assembly Supervisor provides operational leadership for Factory Built Substation (FBS) assembly operations, leading Assembly Technicians and supporting execution across all phases of production. This role is responsible for ensuring Assembly operations are performed safely, efficiently, on schedule, and in accordance with established quality standards.
